Faxe is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment, specifically tracking Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulant therapy using data from DanStroke and the National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. Faxe is one of the 98 municipalities included in this detailed geographic breakdown, which serves as a vital tool for local benchmarking and quality development within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

In the report, Faxe's specific data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is listed in a summary table on page 94 [^src1]. Because the data is thin, no further relationships, timeline events, or specific claims regarding Faxe are available in the provided corpus beyond this single tabular mention.
